specialities.name: Kanchipuram silk saree
specialities.why: Handwoven from pure mulberry silk and heavily embellished with zari, these sarees are world-renowned for their durability and rich contrasting borders.

specialities.name: Kanchipuram Idli
specialities.why: Spiced with black pepper, dry ginger, cumin, and curry leaves, and traditionally steamed inside jackfruit leaves, giving it a distinct aroma.

specialities.name: Temple Hopping
specialities.why: Known as the City of Thousand Temples, Kanchipuram is home to magnificent Pallava-era architectural marvels like the Ekambaranathar and Kailasanathar temples.
